causal_prediction: G23W restores MDM2 association, increases ubiquitination or lowers stability, and reduces p53-R9 apoptosis.
refutation_pattern: No reproducible MDM2-association change in orthogonal assays.
interpretation: W23G contributes causally to escape from MDM2-mediated negative regulation and to the phenotype.
claim_limit: Does not establish organismal cancer resistance or longevity.

causal_prediction: G23W restores MDM2 association and changes turnover but does not reduce mitochondrial apoptosis after abundance normalization.
refutation_pattern: G23W reduces apoptosis in parallel with MDM2/turnover rescue.
interpretation: MDM2 escape is molecularly real but does not explain the Tid1/Bax phenotype.
claim_limit: Other phenotypes of MDM2 escape may remain untested.

causal_prediction: Matched 180-aa canonical constructs reproduce most localization and apoptosis effects regardless of W/G state.
critical_contrast: C2 and C3 versus C4 and C5
refutation_pattern: p53-R9 retains a large phenotype beyond both matched truncation controls.
interpretation: Domain loss rather than a retrogene-specific motif is the main driver.
claim_limit: Engineered truncations may not fold identically to p53-R9.

causal_prediction: p53-R9 has stronger Tid1/Bax interaction and apoptosis than matched truncations, and G23W does not remove this advantage.
refutation_pattern: Matched truncations fully reproduce the p53-R9 phenotype.
interpretation: Other p53-R9 substitutions create a distinct mitochondrial function.
claim_limit: Does not identify which non-W23G substitutions are causal.

causal_prediction: p53-R9 interacts with canonical elephant TP53 and changes its ubiquitination, stability or signaling threshold.
critical_contrast: C6 versus C1 and C7 versus C1
refutation_pattern: No reproducible interaction or canonical-TP53 consequence.
interpretation: p53-R9 can alter canonical TP53 regulation in trans.
claim_limit: Overexpression stoichiometry may not reflect elephant cells.

causal_prediction: MDM2 association depends on tag, cell context, damage state or assay format rather than sequence identity alone.
critical_contrast: Same C4/C5 constructs across orthogonal MDM2 assays and at least two cell contexts
refutation_pattern: Concordant MDM2 result across orthogonal assays and contexts.
interpretation: The JAMA/eLife disagreement reflects measurement context.
claim_limit: A context effect must be reproduced, not inferred from one discordant band.
